core: 【记忆】mag(看作magic， 有魔力的) ＋ net(互联网) → 网络像磁石一样有魔力 → 磁铁， 磁体 | 【短语】permanent magnet (永久磁铁), superconducting magnet (超导磁体；超导磁铁), bar magnet (棒磁铁；条形磁铁)
ex: Prospect Park, with its vast lake, is a magnet for all health freaks.
exz: 拥有大片湖区的展望公园是所有健身迷的向往之地。

en: adj. producing a profit or a useful result
ex: The advertising campaign proved very profitable.
exz: 事实证明，这次广告宣传活动卓有成效。

en: adj. helpful and likely to make you successful
ex: He was now in a more advantageous position.
exz: 他现在的位置更有利。

en: adj. polite and showing respect for other people
ex: The staff are always courteous and helpful.
exz: 员工们总是彬彬有礼、乐于帮助。

zh: n. 有孔小珠；水珠；露珠
en: n. a small piece of glass, wood, etc. with a hole through it, that can be put on a string with others of the same type and worn as jewellery, etc.
core: 【短语】glass bead (玻璃珠), draw bead (张力调整杆；拉深压边筋；拉道), bead welding (堆焊；珠焊；坡口焊；窄焊道焊接)
ex: She wore a string of green glass beads around her neck.
exz: 她脖子上戴着一串绿色的玻璃珠子。

ex: The judge's ruling was based on the simple commonsense tenet that no man is above the law.
exz: 法官的判决基于一个常识性原则，即谁也不能凌驾于法律之上。

en: adj. not liking changes or new ideas
core: 【短语】conservative party (n. 保守党), conservative estimate (审慎估计，保守估计), conservative government (保守政权)
ex: a very conservative attitude to education
exz: 对待教育非常守旧的态度

en: adj. legally responsible for something
core: 【记忆】贴上标签(label)易于(liable)观看 | 【短语】liable for (adj. 对……有责任), liable to tax (应纳税；应课税)
ex: The airline's insurer is liable for damages to the victims' families.
exz: 航空公司投保的保险公司为遇难者家庭的损失负法律责任。

en: n. a large boat with a sail, used for pleasure or sport, especially one that has a place where you can sleep
core: 【记忆】“游特” → 特快的游船 → 快艇 | 【短语】yacht club (游艇俱乐部)
ex: His 36 ft yacht sank suddenly last summer.
exz: 他的36英尺游艇去年夏天突然沉没了。

en: n. a heavy white metal that is radioactive and is used to produce nuclear power and nuclear weapons. It is a chemical element: symbol U
core: 【短语】uranium enrichment (铀浓缩), enriched uranium ([核]浓缩铀), depleted uranium (贫铀；贫化铀)
ex: The fuel was enriched with uranium 235 for the nuclear reactor.
exz: 核反应堆的燃料被铀235浓缩。

zh: n. 油船；空中加油飞机
en: n. a vehicle or ship specially built to carry large quantities of gas or liquid, especially oil
core: 【记忆】“坦克” → 油轮富国， 坦克强兵 → 油轮 | 【短语】oil tanker (油轮；油罐车), chemical tanker (化学液体船；化学品运输船), tanker truck (油罐卡车)
ex: A Greek oil tanker has run aground.
exz: 一艘希腊油轮已经搁浅了。

en: adj. relating to the official system which takes letters from one place to another
core: 【短语】postal service (邮电业), postal savings (邮政储金), postal code (邮政编码，邮递区号)
ex: the U.S. postal service
exz: 美国邮政

en: n. the quality of being better, more skilful, more powerful etc than other people or things
core: 【记忆】来自superior(adj. 优越的) | 【短语】air superiority (空中优势；空优战斗机；空优), superiority complex (优越感；自尊情结；过于自尊), overwhelming superiority (绝对优势)
ex: the intellectual superiority of humans over other animals
exz: 人类相比其他动物所具有的智力优势

en: v. to push someone with your elbows, especially in order to move past them
core: 【短语】elbow joint (n. 肘关节), tennis elbow (肘部发炎；网球运动员常见的肘伤), elbow piece (弯头，肘形配件)
ex: She pushed through the crowd, elbowing people out of the way.
exz: 她用手肘把人们推开，从人群中挤了出来。

en: v. to decorate the walls of a room by covering them with special paper
core: 【短语】on paper (以书面形式；在名义上), paper industry (造纸工业), paper making (n. 造纸)
ex: The previous owners had obviously papered over any damp patches.
exz: 原先的房主显然是用壁纸把潮斑都盖起来了。

en: n. a tool that is used for cutting something
core: 【短语】milling cutter ([机械]铣刀；铣制刀具（等于milling machine）), paper cutter (切纸机，裁纸刀), coal cutter (采煤机；截煤机；切煤机)
ex: wire cutters
exz: 钢丝钳，铁丝剪

en: v. to catch sth, especially fish, in a net
core: 【短语】on the net (在网上), net of (扣除), net profit (净利润)
ex: We netted three fish in under an hour.
exz: 不到一小时我们就网住了三条鱼。

en: v. to hit the ball with your head, especially in football
core: 【短语】head office (总公司；总行), head on (迎面地), head for (前往；出发；取向于)
ex: He headed the ball across the face of the goal.
exz: 他一个头球，球从球门前横飞而过。

zh: v. 用力拖；n. 猛拉，拖
en: v. to pull with one or more short, quick pulls；n. a sudden strong pull
core: 【记忆】“探戈” → 跳探戈时脚步拖拉要有力 → 用力拖 | 【短语】tug of war (拔河，拔河比赛；两派间的激烈竞争), tug boat (拖船；拖轮)
ex: The woman gently tugged his arm.
exz: 那女人轻轻拽了拽他的胳膊。

en: v. to fasten or hang sth on sth else using a hook; to be fastened or hanging in this way
core: 【短语】off the hook ([口]摆脱困境；脱身), on the hook (陷入圈套；拖延), hook up (以钩钩住)
ex: We hooked the trailer to the back of the car.
exz: 我们把拖车挂在汽车尾部。

en: v. to develop something such as a plan or a set of rules, and decide all the details of how it will be done
core: 【记忆】form(形成) ＋ ulate → 构想出
ex: He formulated Labour Party education policy in 1922.
exz: 1922年，他制定了工党教育政策。

en: v. to breathe air in through your nose in order to smell something
core: 【记忆】站在悬崖(cliff)上嗅(sniff)到了危险的气息 | 【短语】sniff out (发现；寻找), sniff at (嗤之以鼻；嗅；轻视)
ex: He opened the milk and sniffed it.
exz: 他打开牛奶闻了闻。

en: adj. brave
ex: He was wrong, and courageous enough to admit it.
exz: 他是错了，而且有勇气承认自己错了。

en: v. to leave your own country to go and live permanently in another country
ex: He emigrated to Belgium.
exz: 他移民去了比利时。

zh: adj. 永久的；四季开花的
en: adj. permanent
core: 【记忆】per(贯穿) ＋ pet(追求) ＋ ual → 自始至终追求的 → 永久的， 永恒的 | 【短语】perpetual motion ([物]永恒运动), perpetual inventory ([经]永续盘存), perpetual motion machine (永动机)
ex: the perpetual snows of the mountaintops
exz: 山顶的终年积雪

en: adj. continuing for ever, even after someone has died
core: 【短语】from everlasting (开天辟地以来，自古以来), everlasting love (永远的爱；不朽之爱), everlasting life (永生；[宗教]来世)
ex: everlasting fame
exz: 永久的名声

en: adj. continuing for ever and having no end
core: 【记忆】外部(external)世界是永恒的(eternal)诱惑 | 【短语】eternal life ([宗]永生；来世), eternal glory (永恒的荣耀), eternal flame (永恒的烈火)
ex: the Christian promise of eternal life
exz: 基督教承诺的永生

core: 【短语】stiffness matrix (刚度矩阵；劲度矩阵), lateral stiffness (横向刚性，横向刚度), static stiffness (静态刚度)
ex: If you eat soon after your workout, you can minimize muscle stiffness and soreness.
exz: 如果在训练不久之后进食，就可以减缓肌肉僵硬和疼痛。

en: v. to do what you have to do or are asked to do
core: 【记忆】com ＋ ply(重) → 观点重合 → 服从 | 【短语】comply with (照做，遵守)
ex: The commander said that the army would comply with the ceasefire.
exz: 指挥官说过部队会遵从停火协议。

en: adj. to be very likely to do or feel a particular thing
core: 【记忆】和round(n. 圆)一起记 | 【短语】upper bound (上界；最大值), bound for (开往…), be bound by (受…约束；由…联系起来)
ex: Don’t lie to her. She’s bound to find out.
exz: 别骗她，她肯定会发现的。

en: v. to move your right hand to your head, especially in order to show respect to an officer in the army, navy etc
ex: The two soldiers saluted Lieutenant Cecil.
exz: 那两名士兵向塞西尔中尉行了礼。

en: v. to provide a particular group of people with the things they need or want
core: 【记忆】cat(小猫) ＋ er → 小猫见主人回来就迎了上去 → 迎合 | 【短语】cater for (迎合；供应伙食；为…提供所需)
ex: We cater to an exclusive clientele.
exz: 我们满足一个特殊客户群的需求。

zh: n. 出版社；印刷所；印刷机
en: n. a business that prints and publishes books
core: 【短语】press conference (记者招待会，新闻发布会), in the press (正在印刷；即将出版), press the button (按钮；按键)

zh: v. 怀着（不好的想法、恐惧或希望）；包含，藏有；窝藏
en: v. to keep bad thoughts, fears, or hopes in your mind for a long time
core: 【短语】pearl harbour (珍珠港), harbour city (海港城（地名，位于香港尖沙咀）), harbour engineering (港湾工程，港口工程；海港工程)
ex: I think he’s harbouring some sort of grudge against me.
exz: 我觉得他对我有点怀恨在心。

zh: n. 日常饮食，日常食物
en: n. the kind of food that a person or animal eats each day
core: 【短语】balanced diet (均衡饮食), on a diet (遵守饮食特别规定的), on diet (节食；减肥)
ex: She doesn’t eat a very healthy diet.
exz: 她的饮食不是很健康。

en: v. to make someone want to have or do something, even though they know they really should not
core: 【记忆】本身为词根， 意为： 尝试 → 因为引起兴趣， 所以要尝试 → 引起…的兴趣
ex: If you leave valuables in your car it will tempt thieves.
exz: 如果把贵重物品留在车上，会招来小偷的。

zh: v. 引证；引用；〔法院〕传召，传讯
en: v. to mention something as an example, especially one that supports, proves, or explains an idea or situation
core: 【记忆】和bite(v. 咬)一起记， 家里的狗咬了人， 所以被传讯 | 【短语】cite an example (举例；引用一个例子)
ex: The judge cited a 1956 Supreme Court ruling in her decision.
exz: 法官在她的判决中引用了1956年最高法院的一项裁决。

en: v. to start burning, or to make something start burning

en: n. the origin of something, especially a word

exz: 去年因为员工生病损失了多少个工作日？

en: n. your mind and your thoughts

en: n. a spoken or written remark about something you have noticed

en: adj. angry or annoyed

en: adj. very unusual or strange

en: n. a group of people who make the laws of a country
core: 【短语】white house (n. 白宫（美国政府的行政机关，美国总统官邸）), in the house (在房子里；在屋子里), publishing house (出版公司，出版社)

en: n. a moral or legal duty to do something

exz: 被父母遗弃的孩子

en: v. to take the place or position of something or someone
core: 【记忆】dis(分离) ＋ place(位置) → 使从位置上离开 → 取代， 替代
ex: Coal has been displaced by natural gas as a major source of energy.

en: n. the act of displacing sb/sth; the process of being displaced

en: n. someone who settles in a new colony

en: adj. made by or for musical instruments

en: adv. divided in an equal way

core: 【记忆】com ＋ pat(=path， 感情) ＋ ible → 有共同感情的 → 能和睦相处的， 合得来的 | 【短语】compatible with (adj. 与……和谐相处；与……相配的)
ex: The new software is IBM compatible (= can be used with IBM computers ) .
exz: 这个新软件与IBM的计算机兼容。

en: n. a short piece of thread that has been sewn into a piece of cloth, or the action of the thread going into and out of the cloth；v. to sew two pieces of cloth together, or to sew a decoration onto a piece of cloth
core: 【短语】a stitch in time (及时处理), stitch length (针距；线圈长度；针迹长度), cross stitch (十字缝；十字针法)
ex: Her mother counted the stitches on her knitting needles.
exz: 她的母亲数了数编织针上的针数。

en: n. a group of people or animals that do something together

exz: 一群猴子

en: n. people who do something in concert do it together after having agreed on it
